comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/favorite-parameters.mitcad-ui (mitcad#2203): the user parameters width = 1200 mm (600 mm to 2400 mm in 10 mm steps, strict: a slider, and a value above the maximum is refused), depth = width / 20 (a formula, 60 mm) and shelves = 4 (no unit), none starred; a 10 x 10 mm board extruded depth high.
